	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;

	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;

	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);

	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);

	[east]	(move_ready = 1) -> ( 1-3*p ):(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[west]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[north]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[south]	(move_ready = 1) -> p:(x' = min (x+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(y' = min (y+1,N)) & (move_ready' = 0) + ( 1-3*p ):(y' = max (y-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0) + p:(x' = max (x-1,0)) & (move_ready' = 0);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & hasCrashed -> (crashed' = 1) & (move_ready' = 1);
	[check]	(move_ready = 0) & !hasCrashed -> (move_ready' = 1);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule

module Knowledge
	xhat:[0..N] init xstart;
	yhat:[0..N] init ystart;
	step:[1..20] init 1;
	ready:[0..1] init 1;

	[west]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = max (xhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[east]	ready = 1 -> (xhat' = min (xhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[south]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = max (yhat-1,0)) & (ready' = 0);
	[north]	ready = 1 -> (yhat' = min (yhat+1,N)) & (ready' = 0);
	[update]	step >= c&ready=0 -> (xhat' = x) & (yhat' = y) & (step' = 1) & (ready' = 1);
	[skip_update]	step < c&ready=0 -> (ready' = 1) & (step' = step+1);
endmodule

module Turn
	t:[0..2] init 0;

	[east]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[west]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[north]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[south]	(t = 0) -> (t' = 1);
	[URC]	(t = 1) -> (t' = 2);
	[update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
	[skip_update]	(t = 2) -> (t' = 0);
endmodule
